classification_basis: The elementary event forms the ethyl radical by addition of H across the ethylene pi bond. It is physically distinct from the frozen 5-hexenyl-radical cyclization family.

theory_source.title: Hierarchical Study of the Reactions of Hydrogen Atoms with Alkenes: A Theoretical Study of the Reactions of Hydrogen Atoms with C2-C4 Alkenes

barrier_quantity.type: source-reported computed activation enthalpy at 0 K, Delta-dagger H_0K, for C2H4 + H -> C2H5
barrier_quantity.method_context: For C2/C3 systems the paper calculates ROCCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVXZ (X=T,Q) single-point energies and extrapolates them to the CBS limit after T1-diagnostic checks; Figure 2 labels the current ethylene-addition rate treatment ROCCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVXZ.
barrier_quantity.typing_firewall: The 11.18 kJ/mol value is retained as Delta-dagger H_0K. It may not be relabeled as a 298 K activation free energy, an experimental Arrhenius activation energy, or a fitted threshold.

high_pressure_rate_model.fit_note: The paper reports high-pressure limiting and pressure-dependent rate calculations using RRKM theory and a one-dimensional master equation. These model rates are not used as the independent observed comparator.

basis: The paper states that the same electronic-structure methods used in prior hierarchical alkene studies were applied across the C2-C4 systems.
The higher-level ROCCSD(T) treatment for ethylene was triggered by T1-diagnostic values, not by choosing the smallest experimental residual.

The paper separately notes that an older Miller-Klippenstein propene treatment altered some barriers to improve agreement; that adjustment is not the source of the 11.18 kJ/mol current-work ethylene barrier.
Experimental comparison is therefore retained as validation context rather than a license to tune or select the 11.18 kJ/mol value.

primary_source.title: Temperature and pressure dependence of the rate constant for the addition of hydrogen atoms to ethylene
primary_source.observable: pressure-dependent H + C2H4 association rate coefficients with high- and low-pressure limits obtained from nonlinear fits
primary_source.visible_expression_fragment: k_inf(T) = (4.39 +/- 0.56) x 10^[superscript lost] exp(-(1087 +/- 36)/T) [cm^3 molecule^-1 s^-1 formatting partially lost]
primary_source.numeric_firewall: The missing power of ten is chemically inferable from secondary knowledge but is not reconstructed by inference here. Exact primary or authoritative machine-readable transcription is required before COMPARATOR_QUALIFIED.

experimental_comparator_trail.independence_note: The selected experiment predates the 2021 theoretical study by 34 years. Temporal separation alone does not prove that the later theory ignored the data, so the method-selection audit above is also required.

condition_audit.note: The theoretical barrier remains a 0 K activation enthalpy descriptor even when paired to a finite-temperature observed rate; any Atlas coordinate must preserve that typing and the selected experimental temperature/pressure regime explicitly.
